address: Houthavenkade 26, Amsterdam-West (Houthavens): 2018 courtyard block of apartments on the Houthavenkade, an eight-storey canal front of orange and dark brick with glass balcony columns over a glazed ground, a set-back glazed top floor and lower brick ranges on the south and west
notes: Houthavenkade 26 (BAG pand 0363100012247232, built 2018, 510 3DBAG wall surfaces, roof max 29.8 m): a large residential block on the Houthavens quay, the 2018 development north of the Westerpark. Five walls were fetched: the north canal front (w01-2, 2025-09-29), the south range (w02-182, 2020-01-29), the west front (w03-272, 2024-10-22), the north-east end (w05-50, 2024-10-09) and a 2016 construction view (w04-140) that shows only the site hoarding.

walls[0] = panel 269 (N, 61 m, eaves 25.5 over a 28.8 m top): orange brick on the west half and dark brown on the east, eight storeys with narrow window columns and glass-railed balcony columns, glazed commercial ground; drawn as 8 storeys x 10 bays with a glazed ground and balconies in every third bay on storeys 2-7. walls[1] = panels 122 (N, ground 25.5): the set-back glazed top floor, one ribbon-window storey. walls[2] = panels 36 and 37 parts (S, 59 m, eaves 10.6, surfaces 37, 98, 251, 252): three storeys of large windows in dark brick over a glazed ground. walls[3] = panel 33 parts (W, surfaces 34, 250, 271, eaves 16.7): six storeys of narrow windows over a glazed shop ground.

Simplified: the orange/dark brick split of the north front is one blended brick colour, the glass balcony columns are slabs with glass rails in every third bay, bays are fewer than the photographed 16 window columns to stay inside 12k triangles, roof terraces and the stepped dark-slate roofs are 3DBAG roof geometry. Surfaces 55, 86, 102, 421 and 425 on the south range (heights 4.4-16.8 m) and everything not listed stay blank wall, the courtyard and east wings not photographed within 35 m.

Re-fit 2026-10-14 (kit vocabulary lane) from w01-2: the north front is two groups on its two 3DBAG surfaces, as the photo splits it: orange brick #b4835c (surfaces 326 and 371, east 31.4 m, the left half seen from the quay; photo raw #bc8f68 in low sun) and dark purple-brown #5e4a44 (surface 316, west 29 m; photo raw #69544a), both glazed-columns: full-height enclosed glass balcony bays 0.45 m deep with a slab at every storey line from storey 1 up, grey reflective glass #8e9ea4 (photo raw #8ea2a6 / #949496). Orange: 21 bays of 1.5 m, four two-bay columns (centres 3.0, 12.0, 17.9, 26.9 m; photo 2.7, 11.7, 17.6, 26.5 m) and narrow windows 0.5 x 0.6 between them; dark: 11 bays of 2.64 m, columns in bays 1, 4, 7 (centres 4.0, 11.9, 19.8 m; photo 4.4, 11.9, 19.4 m) and large windows 0.66 x 0.72. Sources are listed in wall-group order (the sheet pairs them positionally).
Budget (12k): the orange half's narrow windows have no frame ring (frames false), 12.4k with one.

Measured 2026-10-14 (measure.ts, evidence in measured.json): groups 0, 1, 3, 4 take the photo's wall and glass colour, window shape, bay count and front class; walls[0] glass #726f5d not used (not darker than the wall #917b5c by 10 L*, or tinted): kit glass kept; walls[1] glass #3f4248 not used (not darker than the wall #494341 by 10 L*, or tinted): kit glass kept; walls[3] glass #575960 not used (not darker than the wall #615b54 by 10 L*, or tinted): kit glass kept; walls[4] glass #2f557d not used (not darker than the wall #524c52 by 10 L*, or tinted): kit glass kept.

Reconciled 2026-10-14 (lane A measurement on lane C's systems): lane C's two groups on the two 3DBAG surfaces of the north front replace lane A's wallSplit (hand wallSplit on both: the colour change is the group boundary). `hand` holds the system, bays and column placement of walls[0] and [1] (lane C). Walls measured from w01-2L (2019): walls[0] #917b5c (yellow-brown, lane C's hand #b4835c came from the 2025 low-sun crop), walls[1] #494341; walls[3] #615b54 with 6 measured bays (lane C kept the original 9), walls[4] #524c52 with 7. Glass: the measured window glass is not darker than the brick on any front (measure.ts keeps the kit's dark glass), while the balcony columns are reflective grey: the new `columns.glass` carries lane C's hand sample #8e9ea4 for the columns only. windowShape: walls[0] measured and refined (0.36 x 0.75: the narrow windows between the columns); walls[1] measured 0.65 x 0.65 kept by hand (the refinement loop shrank it to 0.2 wide slits because the photo classes those panes as trim and undercounts glazing at 0.33); walls[3] measured 0.65 x 0.60 kept by hand for the same reason (refined 0.34 read square, the photo is wide); walls[4] lane A's hand 0.35 x 0.80 (measured 0.30 x 0.20 misses the tall windows behind Juliet bars). On glazed-columns the measured mean glazing mixes the columns with the punched windows, so the refinement of windowShape there only means the windows between the columns.
Kit gap: the columns' mid-height transoms and corner frames, Juliet bars on walls[4], brick shop piers on the glazed ground, the set-back roof storey's terraces.

Refit 2026-10-25 (issue #59): g1 punched balcony windows smaller (photo glazing 0.41), g3 12 tall cross windows over a windowed brick ground, g4 narrow windows shortening on the top two storeys over a brick ground with the shop (photo ground glazing 13 %), inside the 12k pilot budget. walls[2] has no reference panel.
